title: [Bug][SubscriptionBilling]: "Prices Including VAT" handling is incomplete — contract billing invoice treats VAT‑exclusive Subscription Line amounts as VAT‑inclusive
summary: The Subscription Billing contract billing feature now correctly grosses up net prices to VAT-inclusive amounts when a customer or vendor uses prices including VAT, ensuring VAT calculations reconcile with the original order.
key_points: Added a helper function to convert net prices to VAT-inclusive prices by applying the line's VAT factor
Applied the gross-up logic at all price-assignment sites for both sales (Unit Price) and purchase (Direct Unit Cost) paths
Zero-VAT and full-VAT lines are excluded from the conversion logic
Comprehensive test coverage added for VAT-inclusive and VAT-exclusive scenarios for both customer and vendor billing
Change is gated on the document header's Prices Including VAT flag and does not affect other documents
quote: the contract invoice was created with the net (VAT-exclusive) amount placed onto a Prices Including VAT = YES document
